title: Mycelium Vein
description: The tunnel wall is shot through with thick veins of glowing mycelium, each strand pulsing with bioluminescent light. The network runs deep into the rock -- you could spend hours tracing its branches, or harvest what you can reach and move on.

choices.label: Harvest carefully
choices.description: Take your time and extract the fungal fibers properly.

outcomes.text: Patience rewards you. The fibers come free in long, unbroken strands -- exactly what crafters pay well for.
The vein runs deeper than expected. As you follow it, you uncover a pocket of crystallized spore clusters embedded in the rock.
The vein secretes a sticky, irritating sap as you cut. It stings but you work through it, collecting decent fiber.

choices.label: Rip the veins out
choices.description: Tear the mycelium free quickly, but risk a spore burst.

outcomes.text: The veins tear free with a satisfying rip. Spore dust fills the air but dissipates quickly -- more bark than bite.
The wall erupts in a choking cloud of spores. You shield your face but inhale a lungful before the air clears.
The veins come free easily and you find a buried cache of fungal materials -- someone tried to hide their haul behind the growth.

choices.label: Look for spore clusters
choices.description: Where mycelium grows thick, spore clusters often form.

outcomes.text: You trace the veins to their thickest junction. Sure enough -- fat spore clusters cling to the convergence point.
The clusters here are enormous, pulsing with bioluminescent light. Among them you spot a rare glowing spore.
You reach for a cluster and it bursts on contact, spraying your face with stinging spore fluid. The remaining clusters are smaller than you hoped.
